source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: Every 15-year-old applicant must show a certified U.S. birth certificate, and a foreign birth certificate must be translated into English and embassy-certified unless the person has a U.S. passport.
Class D with a Y restriction is the car learner license, whereas Class M with a B restriction is limited to motor driven cycles for riders aged 14 or 15.
Watch closely for cyclists at intersections, when crossing sidewalks, and when entering or leaving alleys or driveways.
corrections.note: Full sentence starts on page 26 and continues on page 27.

corrections.corrected_statement: Wind direction and velocity affect stopping distance and drivers may not realize the difference a strong tail wind can make when trying to stop suddenly at high speed.
corrections.note: Page says difference, not that it lengthens the stop.

corrections.corrected_statement: You must stop when the crossing gate is down or a train is approaching, and with more than one track you must be sure every track is clear before crossing.
corrections.note: The multi-track condition starts on page 41, not page 42.

corrections.corrected_statement: A left turn on red after stopping is allowed only from a one-way street onto a one-way street whose traffic moves right to left.
When two vehicles from different roads reach an uncontrolled intersection at about the same time, the one on the left yields to the one on the right.
Except when backing into a parking place, it is never advisable to back on a public street or road and you should follow the same backing rules when entering a traffic lane after angle parking.
corrections.note: Changed absolute never back prohibition to never advisable.

corrections.corrected_statement: A fifteen year old with a valid learner license may drive only when accompanied by a parent or legal guardian or licensed driver at least twenty one years old occupying the front seat beside the driver or by a licensed or certified driving instructor occupying the front seat beside the driver.
corrections.note: Statement omits the allowed licensed or certified driving instructor supervisor.

corrections.corrected_statement: A restricted driver may not drive between twelve midnight and six in the morning unless accompanied by a parent or legal guardian or unless accompanied by a licensee at least twenty one years old with parental consent or going to or from regular work or a school sponsored event or a religious sponsored event or driving for a medical fire or law enforcement emergency.
corrections.note: Statement omits workplace and school and religious event exceptions plus parent guardian accompaniment.

corrections.corrected_statement: A fifteen year old learner must be accompanied by a parent or guardian or licensed driver at least twenty one years old occupying the front seat beside the driver or by a licensed or certified driving instructor occupying the front seat beside the driver while a restricted sixteen year old may have no more than one nonfamily passenger besides a parent or guardian or supervising licensed driver at least twenty one years old.
corrections.note: Statement omits that the supervisor must occupy the front seat beside the driver.

corrections.corrected_statement: Research puts the start of impairment for most drivers at.05 percent, below the.08 percent level that makes driving unlawful.
corrections.note: The .08 unlawful limit is stated on page 35, not on cited page 34.
